navaid.name: Hornbjarg
navaid.description: The Hornbjargsviti Lighthouse accommodates a total of 40 people has 7 separate rooms, kitchen, toilet, shower and facilities for drying clothes. Outside, there's a camping ground with toilets and cooking facilities in an old sheep house.
